Phyllis Quek as Yin Susu

In this promotional still from the 2002 television adaptation of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, Singaporean actress Phyllis Quek embodies the martial heroine Yin Susu. Dressed in a flowing pink robe adorned with delicate beadwork and head ornaments, she stands against a softly blurred natural backdrop, her serene expression and poised posture conveying both grace and strength.
